final.summary: Gate.io PLAY funding spiked to ~+231% APR, indicating heavy long crowding on a micro-cap, high-vol name (ATR ~10%/day). Severity 3 and only moderate divergence across venues tempers the signal, but combined with a 24h cluster of alt funding extremes (LSK, POWR, STEEM, CVC, BSP) it flags elevated short-squeeze-unwind / liquidation cascade risk across alts. We have no direct PLAY position; impact is indirect via alt contagion. Action: do not initiate new PLAY longs, and tighten stops on existing alt longs (BNB/SOL/UNI/XRP) on account 14. Confidence is moderate (0.55) because PLAY is small-cap, the spike is single-venue, and no direct exposure exists — outcome is more a risk-management trigger than a directional PLAY trade.
